after.buffer_scope: Each of nine effects: initial ticks 0,1,2 at 32x20; same options after stop/reconfigure and after repeated dispose reproduce color/light SHA and done state. This is bounded reproducibility, not a new full-sequence TS parity run.
after.leak_scope: Old effect dictionaries and captured scopes are empty after replacement. Headless after/control test exits had no engine error or leaked-object warnings; not a sustained memory profile.

host_controls.scope: Real Pickup replay and Sparkle situation-switch ownership; spy effect isolates pause/update/draw scheduling and done-hold replay. Includes repeated exit disposal.
host_controls.pause_contract: Pause freezes simulation calls, buffers, warmup, accumulator and replay countdown. Explicit R/left/right/C/S user inputs remain enabled and may reset/collect/stop while paused.
